user.title: Choose the receiver
user.description: Choose the dimmer that controls the ceiling light. Enter the existing mesh passphrase and the switch's four-digit hexadecimal source ID from the captures.

learn.title: Press ON on the wall switch
learn.description: Briefly press ON on the physical switch now. Wait until the lamp is on, then select Submit. This learns the group and location from a fresh authenticated switch message.

off.title: Test OFF
off.description: Make sure the ceiling light is on before starting the test. Submit to send OFF to the wall switch's group {group}. Other lights in that group can also turn off. {detail}

on.title: Test ON
on.description: Submit to send ON to group {group}. The next step asks you to confirm whether the lamp responded. {detail}

confirm.title: Did the ceiling light respond?
confirm.description: Select the checkbox if the intended lamp turned off and then on. If either test failed, submit with the box clear.

data.observed: I saw the intended lamp turn off and then on

direct.title: Try direct control
direct.description: Submit to ask {name} for an authenticated name reply. The reply gives Home Assistant the receiver's mesh address. Diagnostics also read the reported brightness after each direct test. {detail}

data.read_back: Read lamp status after each test

direct_off.title: Test direct OFF
direct_off.description: Turn the lamp on at the wall if needed. Submit to send OFF directly to {name}. Watch for the ceiling light to turn off. {detail}

direct_on.title: Test direct ON
direct_on.description: Submit to send ON directly to {name}. Watch for the ceiling light to turn on. {detail}

direct_confirm.title: Did the lamp respond to direct control?

data.observed: I saw the intended lamp turn off and then on

error.no_press: No matching ON message yet. Press ON again. Check the switch ID, passphrase and Bluetooth range.
error.ble_failed: Bluetooth test failed. See the details above and the Home Assistant log.
error.no_name_reply: Could not identify the receiver over Bluetooth. See the details above.

abort.not_pill: This device is not a recognized @MC dimmer.
abort.no_devices: Home Assistant has not seen a connectable @MC dimmer advertising FEF1. Close the SG phone app, check Bluetooth and try again.
abort.no_advertisement_response: BlueZ accepted both advertising tests. You reported that the lamp did not respond as expected.

init.title: Brightness
init.description: Enable brightness after the ON/OFF test. Setup reads the receiver's name, mesh address and status. The slider uses absolute percent and reads back the result. Clear the checkbox for ON/OFF only. {detail}

advertised_dimming.title: Choose dimming
advertised_dimming.description: Try brightness in percent to add a slider. If the lamp only responds to the dimming commands used by the wall switch, choose Dim up and down.

dim_first.title: Test lower brightness
dim_first.description: Turn the lamp up before testing. Submit to send 30% or Dim down, depending on your selection. Watch for the lamp to dim. {detail}

dim_second.title: Test higher brightness
dim_second.description: Submit to send 70% or Dim up. Watch for the lamp to get brighter. {detail}

dim_confirm.title: Did the lamp respond?
dim_confirm.description: Select the checkbox if the lamp got dimmer and then brighter. Leave it clear to try another dimming method.

data.observed: I saw the lamp get dimmer and then brighter

error.no_status: Could not verify the receiver's name and status. ON/OFF remains usable. See the details above.
error.dim_test_failed: Could not send the dim command. See the details above.
